<p>Back in my fun days, I sure did hate the 11 AM kick-off. Some of you may recall the television station Jefferson Pilot…they broadcasted the dreaded early 11:30 am kickoff, and “getting JP’d” was an insult in many ways. It ruined recovery time from a late Friday night. Also, the weaker teams were exclusively slotted for this early morning time in the past, so it was a call to arms when it happened to the Tide. But this weekend…I kind of liked the 11 am kick! We got our business done first and then could just relax…it really helped that our beloved Crimson Tide came to win Saturday even inspiring a surrender cobra in the first quarter…almost overshadowing the unhappy girl next to the cobra who appears to be wearing nothing but a hat!?! I guess flaunt it if you got it but seems like mississippi would have rules about showing up naked to games!?</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="image" height="171" width="320"></p><p>Here’s our dashing Coach entering davis wade stadium dressed for success, and when you look at the numbers, the win was as impressive as his look.&nbsp;</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64," height="180" width="320"></p><p>Keelon had the most scramble yards of any qb coming into the game Saturday and is now in 2nd place for the Heisman according to Fan Duel Sports. UA is averaging 49.6 points per game in its first five games. 56 points in our ms st game marks the most points Alabama has scored versus a ranked opponent on the road in program history, and Coach DeBoer is 5-0 for the first time in his tenure at Alabama! There were so many great catches and performances - Talty even kicked a <em>field goal</em> that resulted in <em>seven points</em> when ms st got a penalty for roughing the kicker…giving us first down that led to a TD! And let’s not forget that great hurdle by tight end Marshall Pritchett since none of the networks showed it in our game highlights…</p><p><a href="https://x.com/aldotcomtide/status/2106461272455700891?s=46&amp;t=XbZxpV7Nr8sroVf69IdfSA" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://x.com/aldotcomtide/status/2106461272455700891?s=46&amp;t=XbZxpV7Nr8sroVf69IdfSA</a></p><p>Our defense has the most takeaways (13) in the sec with four alone against the pups of Mississippi! The Tide holds the record for most defensive touchdowns in the FBS and our rush defense allowed just 18 yards Saturday.&nbsp;</p><p>We are not going to talk about penalties. It was messy, but our talent overcame it all. And then, having won our game handily, all we had to do the rest of the day was relax and make fun of other teams! That’s the glory of the early kick.&nbsp;</p><p>Minnesota continued to kick michigan when they were down and the joy from the Golden Gophers locker room represents all we love about this sport.&nbsp;</p><p><a href="https://x.com/aaron_torres/status/2106508230419796479?s=46&amp;t=XbZxpV7Nr8sroVf69IdfSA" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://x.com/aaron_torres/status/2106508230419796479?s=46&amp;t=XbZxpV7Nr8sroVf69IdfSA</a></p><p>And with a primo <em>Vomit Bucket Bowl</em> played in ut vs. the aubs, there was a good bit of material to ridicule this weekend.&nbsp;&nbsp;During the first quarter, I thought they might go into OT at 0-0 as this brilliant post notes</p><p><a href="https://x.com/itsjustbam3/status/2106502757717037094?s=12" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://x.com/itsjustbam3/status/2106502757717037094?s=12</a></p><p>But there was an impressive defensive play against the terribly strong booger defender by an official…&nbsp;</p><p><a href="https://x.com/_america_proud_/status/2106512709600833571/video/1?s=46" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://x.com/_america_proud_/status/2106512709600833571/video/1?s=46</a></p><p>But both teams managed to score in the second quarter. I think the main story of this game was obviously tennesee’s uniforms…what is up with their new helmets? They added-a-color to their uniform repertoire (“smokey gray”) in 2022 they debuted against lsu. And as we all know, “adding-a-color” is the kiss of death…a sign indicating a program must do something (ie. add-a-color) to keep their program fresh, because the performance is rancid (looking at you too ga - added black shirts in 2007, ole miss - baby blue jerseys in 2020 and, of course, oregon whose unis change weekly). The add-a-color is a distraction that prevents focusing on the big prize, and the vols took it to new heights Saturday in the alteration of their add-a-color gray helmets by removing the orange “T” on the side of the helmet this year and replacing it with orange lines and a teeny tiny white “ut” on the front of the helmet…</p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="IMG_8675.jpeg" height="240" width="320"></p><p>proving they are not serious contenders for a national championship.&nbsp;</p><p>A slight overreaction to helmet choices you might say? Perhaps, but Athletic Departments do not have a ten-minute conversation and then call it a day about which color they might add to their uniform collection…<em>should they even consider adding a color</em> is probably a huge study or committee itself. Best case scenario their assistant director of equipment’s cousin Fred got a good deal on gray helmets and gray jersey materials which means somebody made a lot of money under the table, but you are still coming out way ahead of a thorough analysis. Worst case scenario their apparel provider hired consultants to research and survey the financial impact of introducing a new color and what color would be well received by fans, students, prospective students and alumni…along with presentations, meetings and more meetings…wasting countless staff hours, resources and funds to come to the conclusion that smokey gray (not smoked gray or dark smokey gray but “smokey gray”) along with replacing the “T” on the helmet with orange stripes would restore order and energy to the program. This may be an appropriate goal for Project Runway contestants but never the focus of a soon-to-be championship program is my long-winded point. And I am slightly offended if you think I am I trying too hard to find new ways to dislike tennessee.</p><p>DISCLAIMER: I am not implying I was rooting for the boogs to win that game but at least their unis are clean looking.&nbsp;</p><p>Moving on…honestly, basking in our greatness, the drama of the day did not phase Alabama fans much, but there was a lot of it.&nbsp;</p><p>tcu’s fans are wearing bags of shame and ready to fire their head coach sonny dykes.&nbsp;</p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="IMG_8694" height="240" width="320"></p><p>&nbsp;While colorado state’s defensive coordinator tyson summers was fired by head coach jim mora jr DURING their game against oregon state when summers walked off the field in the middle of play?!&nbsp;</p><p><a href="https://www.facebook.com/share/r/19SZroJhuu/?mibextid=wwXIfr" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://www.facebook.com/share/r/19SZroJhuu/?mibextid=wwXIfr</a></p><p>But on a positive note - how about iowa state’s <em>running back </em>Aiden Flora leading his team in <em>touchdown passes</em> joining the ranks of Vince Young with his rushing/passing/scoring accomplishments Saturday.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="IMG_8698.jpeg" height="240" width="320"></p><p>&nbsp;And the most inspiring play of the weekend has to be yale’s QB Dante Reno’s winning performance throwing four touchdown passes for 298 yards after his father Coach Tony Reno, former yale coach, passed away on Friday…remarkable fortitude.</p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="IMG_8701.jpeg" height="240" width="320"></p><p>&nbsp;Hug your dad if you can, y’all.&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;We also saw kentucky’s coach stein do his best impression of pete golding and go for an unforced two-point conversion to beat south cackalacky outright as opposed to kicking an extra point and facing them in a second overtime…resulting in the biggest road comeback in uk history. florida coach sumrall’s channeling of his inner pete was less impressive…just as the rebels choked against the gators, proving winning was not their signature look, florida let their own hype get the best of them. The gators treated the ole miss win last week as a season-defining crown, and mizzou brought them back to reality with an embarrassing upset.&nbsp;</p><p>But oh my, there’s a big one coming up this weekend and I don’t mean tx and ok’s battle for the <em>golden hat </em>in the red river rivalry. Not going to be much there to see considering the okies are the only power four team michigan has beat this season - fool’s gold is all the sooners will touch that’s glittery this Saturday (sorry, “fools gold” was extra corny). The big event, of course, is the Tide’s game against the fighting kirbys. It should prove to be as substantial a showdown as the ole miss vs. lsu game minus all the hate (hopefully) with ESPN Game Day, the President and a tropical storm all coming to Tuscaloosa Saturday! georgia came out a little slow against vandy this weekend which likely means they were already looking ahead to Alabama…I’m soooo nervous…who’s with me?! </p><p>&nbsp;Y’all did a great job last week of washing your lucky undies <em>twice</em> to ensure Alabama was prepared for <em>two halves</em> of production in starkville (as we found earlier this season one washing of lucky drawers resulted in success in <em>only</em> the first half <em>or</em> <em>just</em> in the second half but <em>not both </em>halves). Let’s keep up the same lucky underwear hygiene habits this week please…two washes of your lucky panties = two halves of hard play...as was proven beyond a shadow of a doubt against ms st, right? And we all have to do our part...maybe even throw some fabric softener in with your game day undies to work on those penalties…no…we don’t need to get softer, do we? Stain remover…that’s it! Spray those flaws and blemishes out of our game please! </p><p>&nbsp;Let’s suit up for the win and ruff up (eek...more corniness) those athens puppies! RTR and enjoy Week 6!</p><p>Jackie&nbsp;</p>
